events.n: [1] Exhibited at De Hauke and Co., New York, in 1928, on loan from Mrs. Lotus Robb Smith, possibly through Reinhardt gallery. See de Hauke records in Seligmann papers at Archives of American Art, boxes 386 and 406 (copies NGA curatorial files). Published in Robb's collection in _Parnassus_, March 1931.
events.q: probably by whom sold by 1928 to Mrs. Lotus Robb Smith, New York, until at least 1931

events.n: [2] See Weitzner receipt dated 20 October 1950 in NGA curatorial files. The anonymous collector who sold Weitzner the painting is almost certainly Mr. Smith, whom Lotus Robb divorced c. 1937. She later married Mr. Marvin Ross, who detailed how she returned the paintings to her former husband when they divorced, and he immediately sold them; see note by David Rust dated January 1965 in NGA curatorial files.
events.q: Sold 1937 by an anonymous collector to (Julius H. Weitzner [1896-1986], London and New York)
